name: portal-v2-empty-state-surface-preservation
purpose: Preserve protected Portal V2 decision surfaces even when customer data is missing, partial or not yet loaded, while keeping customer truth separate from derived Powerhouse signals.
trigger_when: changing Portal V2 overview or navigation
migrating a protected legacy capability into V2
changing profile, maturity, adoption, blocker or organisation-status rendering
required_behavior: Read the current parity inventory and relevant learning fingerprint before changing the surface.
Keep the complete protected surface structurally present for populated, partial and empty customer states.
Represent missing truth explicitly as unknown, not-filled or not-determined; never synthesize a maturity stage, CMMI score, blocker or customer answer.
Keep global navigation reachable inside opened Portal V2 workspaces.
Use canonical customer state as truth; derived Powerhouse signals remain separately labelled and may not backfill missing customer answers.
Add regression coverage for populated, partial and empty states.
Require exact-head Portal V2 tests plus production DOM/readback before claiming LIVE_AND_PROVEN.
Write root cause, failed attempts, fix, regression and production evidence back to canonical Powerhouse learning.
forbidden_patterns: collapse multiple protected management surfaces into one empty-state sentence
hide adoption curve or organisation-state UI because profile data is absent
invent default CMMI or adoption stage in customer-facing truth
treat code presence as equivalent to production rendering
create a parallel portal truth or duplicate persistence path
